name: Log Shopee Ads Balance Requests with Tesseract, Google Drive and Sheets

parameters.content:
## Log Shopee Ads Balance Requests with Tesseract, Google Drive and Sheets

### How it works

A salesperson submits a Shopee ads balance request through the form and uploads the payment screenshot. Tesseract reads the screenshot, then the workflow builds the request record, runs a deterministic OCR check and an AI verification, and only stores the request when the details are complete. Verified requests are checked against the log to avoid duplicates, the proof is uploaded to Google Drive, the request is appended to Google Sheets, and finance and the admin are notified on email and Telegram. Anything ambiguous goes to a manual review lane instead of being logged. Every Monday a scheduled lane reads the week's requests, sums the balance topped up and sends an AI written recap.

### Setup steps

- Create the request form so sellers can submit brand, requester, financing type, channel and the payment screenshot.
- Connect Tesseract to read the proof, Google Drive for the proof folder, Google Sheets for the request log and Telegram for notifications.
- Add a Gmail credential for finance notifications and an OpenAI compatible model credential for the AI verification and recap.
- Set the finance email address in the Build Request Payload node. Change the weekly recap schedule in the Weekly Recap Trigger if needed.

### Customization

Point the Google Drive folder and Google Sheets tab to your own files, adjust the OCR parsing rules in Build Request Payload, change the AI verification prompt, and edit the alert messages to match your finance workflow.

## Intake and OCR

Captures the request form, runs Tesseract OCR on the payment screenshot and builds the structured request fields.

## AI verification

A language model cross-checks the OCR output. Requests that cannot be verified are routed to the manual review lane.

## Manual review lane

Unclear screenshots are flagged to Telegram and email instead of being logged, so nothing enters the log silently.

## Duplicate guard

If the same amount and account already appear in the log, the request is flagged and skipped.

## Store, log and notify

Verified requests are uploaded to Drive, appended to the log, then finance gets an email and the admin gets a Telegram message.

## Weekly recap

Every Monday the log is summarized: count and total topped up, written by AI and sent to Telegram and email.

assignments.name: No Rek / VA
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const t = $json.text || ''; const va = t.match(/Virtual Account\s*(\d[\d ]*\d)/i); if (va) return va[1].replace(/ /g, ''); const acc = t.match(/(?:Bank\s*)?BCA\s*(\d[\d ]*\d)/i); if (acc) return acc[1].replace(/ /g, ''); const any = t.match(/\b\d{8,}\b/); return any ? any[0] : ''; })() }}

assignments.name: Sumber OCR
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const t = $json.text || ''; if (/Virtual Account\s*\d/i.test(t)) return 'va'; if (/(?:Bank\s*)?BCA\s*\d/i.test(t)) return 'bca'; if (/\b\d{8,}\b/.test(t)) return 'fallback'; return 'gagal'; })() }}

assignments.name: Validasi
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const t = $json.text || ''; const nom = (t.match(/(?:Total Pembayaran|Total Tagihan|Nominal)\s*:?\s*Rp\s*([\d.,]+)/i) || ['',''])[1].replace(/[.,]/g, ''); let rek = ''; let sumber = 'gagal'; const va = t.match(/Virtual Account\s*(\d[\d ]*\d)/i); if (va) { rek = va[1].replace(/ /g, ''); sumber = 'va'; } else { const acc = t.match(/(?:Bank\s*)?BCA\s*(\d[\d ]*\d)/i); if (acc) { rek = acc[1].replace(/ /g, ''); sumber = 'bca'; } else { const any = t.match(/\b\d{8,}\b/); if (any) { rek = any[0]; sumber = 'fallback'; } } } const masalah = []; if (!rek) masalah.push('no rek tidak ditemukan'); else if (rek.length < 15 && rek.length !== 10) masalah.push('panjang rek ' + rek.length + ' digit tidak umum'); if (!/^\d{3,}$/.test(nom)) masalah.push('nominal tidak valid'); return masalah.length ? 'CEK MANUAL (' + sumber + '): ' + masalah.join('; ') : 'OK (' + sumber + ')'; })() }}

options.systemMessage: You are a finance operations assistant checking OCR output for Shopee ads balance top-up requests. The seller submits a payment screenshot as proof. Confirm whether a monetary amount (nominal) and a bank account or virtual account number are clearly present in the OCR text. Respond with JSON only, no markdown, no code fences, with exactly these keys: ok (true only when both nominal and account are clearly present), nominal (the digits found, or an empty string), account (the account or VA digits found, or an empty string), note (a short reason when ok is false, otherwise an empty string).

options.systemMessage: You write short finance operation recaps in plain text. Start with a headline line of at most 12 words, then 2 to 4 bullet lines starting with "- ". Include the total amount topped up and the number of requests. Max 100 words, no markdown, no JSON, no code fences.
